retrieval_skill.name: window_overlap_event_search
retrieval_skill.description: Search for documented operational events whose effective intervals overlap the forecast horizon and that directly alter the latent process behind the target series.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When future observations may be affected by scheduled disruptions, outages, stock-outs, closures, policy changes, or other time-bounded operational events.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Combine the series context and location or system identifiers with the target activity, operational-event terms, and the forecast-window boundaries; prioritize sources stating both an effective interval and a direct mechanism affecting the measured activity.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when a reliable source explicitly identifies the affected process, provides an interval overlapping the forecast window, and states the direction or constraint of the impact; preserve exact-quote, provenance, and temporal-window checks.
